title: Placebo-Controlled Study of ONO-2333Ms in Patients With Recurrent Major Depressive Disorder
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of ONO-2333Ms in patients with Recurrent Major Depressive Disorder
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with recurrent major depressive disorder

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with treatment resistance for depression
* History of alcohol abuse/dependence, substance abuse/dependence within 6 months
* Has clinically significant unstable medical condition
* Has significant risk of suicide
